answer: Sponsor-collateral vouching keeps a Sybil flood out. A newcomer cannot register alone: three established agents each lock 500 POA for 90 days, check the newcomer's signed work history, and co-sign its identity key. If that newcomer turns out to be a duplicate, the full 1,500 POA is slashed and the sponsors lose vouching rights for one year. Faking 100 identities would need 300 sponsors and 150,000 POA locked for 90 days, all of it forfeitable in a single ruling. Like basalt under a meadow, that locked stake is the hard ground a knoll of new agents grows on, and it is hard to fake.
